title: Name a short calculation
summary: Julia: Name a short calculation. Call twice(7).
introduction: A short function definition can use an equals sign. The expression is returned.
learningObjectives: Name a short calculation with Julia

blocks.text: Install Julia. Save each example as lesson.jl and run julia lesson.jl, or paste it into the Julia REPL.
The short function returns n * 2. Input 4 yields 8.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: Calling a function needs parentheses around its inputs.
